source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Kids a Cookin’, Kansas Family Nutrition Program

steps.instruction: Cream 1/2 cup of shortening and 3/4 cup of sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer.
Add 2 large eggs and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and mix well.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of flour and 1 teaspoon of baking powder in a medium bowl.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Add the flour mixture and 1 cup of mashed banana to the creamed mixture and mix well.
Line a muffin tin with paper baking cups, or coat it with cooking spray.
Fill the muffin cups 2/3 full of batter.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to twenty-two minutes, until golden brown.

steps.instruction: Remove the cupcakes from the tin and place them on a rack to cool.
